text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Former president Kamuzu Banda, leader of the main opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP), would make any final decision on merging with another opposition party, the Alliance for Democracy, MCP Treasurer-General John Tembo said.
- Malawi's ninth international trade fair opened on Thursday in Blantyre with 10 foreign companies and 150 local firms participating.
- Malawi's immigration department has ordered a Kenyan national out of the country or face deportation over allegations that he swindled Malawians out of millions.
